lines.text: I arrive near the dormitory building.
But...
Uh.
I spot a familiar figure disappearing into the dorm.
I follow Arcana inside.
Aquamarine-colored hair disappears down the far end of the hallway.
*Step, step*
I walk down the hallway toward the corner.
Blue hair peeks out from around the corner...
... Keep walking.
... Stop and hold my breath.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Boo!
Hi.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What? You didn't get scared?
I could see your hair.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh...
Arcana grabs her hair and examines it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess my hair's gotten longer so I miscalculated.
Now that you mention it...
Arcana's hair almost reaches her calves.
When we first met, it was around your hips, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. I've been growing it ever since.
Isn't it uncomfortable when it's that long?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Washing and drying it is a huge chore.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But still...
Arcana gently sways the tip of her hair in front of me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you think?
... It's pretty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Let's go.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I need to return your gym uniform back.
Soon, silence fills the hallway.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: H-hey. You're there, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Laughs awkwardly* You're scaring me.
*Rustle*
With the rustling of clothes, Arcana peeks her head out from the end of the hallway...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Gaaaah!
Arcana meets my eyes as I crouch there, then lets out a scream and collapses.
Hi.
Arcana looks up with slightly teary eyes, then takes the hand I offer and stands up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... You scared me.
I thought you said you weren't afraid of ghosts.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's not that ghosts scare me.
Arcana grabs the hem of my clothes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That... no.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... What scares me is you disappearing.
Why would I disappear?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I suppose I'm the one who disappeared first.
Arcana brushes off the hem of her skirt.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, let's go.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I need to return your gym uniform back.
Arcana takes my hand.
I follow Arcana into her dorm room.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Welcome.
Oh, right. Sorry for the intrusion.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I do have a roommate, but she won't be coming right away, so it's fine.
You're talking about Amy, right?
She mentioned it earlier when I was asking her where you went.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What about you?
Me?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Who's your roommate?
I have my room to myself.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What??

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is your room better than ours too?
Uh... yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow. Special treatment.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a double room, but we only have one closet.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess since everyone wears a uniform, we don't exactly have that many clothes too.
Arcana opens the closet.
You already put my shirt in there?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course. Everything has to be neatly organized.
Arcana takes out my gym shirt off the hanger.
Even so...

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Don't forget our promise.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: No making a mess!
Upon entering the room, the interior space, to put it charitably, has a "lived-in" feel.
To put it bluntly...
It's a total pigsty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know I don't have any memory of that time!
Phantom said you've always been that way.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Tch.
Arcana puffs out her cheeks while looking at me.
Anyway, Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes?
How should I put this...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What is it?
Um... you seem a bit different from before.
Arcana drops the clothes she is holding.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Th-that...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Isn't that what people say before they break up with someone?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: First it's that, then, "I liked you better before," or "I just don't feel that spark anymore!"
No, no, no. It's nothing like that.
How should I put it... you seem more honest.
You were always expressive to begin with, but now it feels like there's even more range to your emotions.
Getting sulky, getting angry... things like that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mmm...
Arcana picks up my gym uniform she dropped and shakes it off.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That... might be true.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I certainly feel more comfortable than I did before.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So I'm a bit more... casual? More natural?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In the way I treat you?
Does that mean you've stopped putting on an act?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a little different from that.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There's no girl in the world who doesn't put on a bit of an act.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Especially in front of someone she's interested in.
Y-yeah...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: How should I put it...
Arcana looks down at my gym shirt.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I feel like I've started to have certain expectations.
Expectations?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it feels like even if I act like this, you'll accept it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Or rather, that I hope you will.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I hope you'll cherish me and find me cute no matter what version of myself I am.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I hope you'll like me... no matter what side of me you see.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That kind of expectation.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Um...
*Beep, beep, beep*
At that moment, I hear the sound of someone entering the door code.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, oh...?!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I-I think Amy is back...!
Arcana quickly moves away from me and looks around.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Y-you've gotta hide!
O-okay...!
I hurriedly look for a place to hide.
There aren't many choices, and time is tight.
Hide in the closet.
Hide in the bed.
I quickly jump into the still-open closet and shut the door.
Just as I'm shutting the door, I can hear the sound of the front door opening.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: H-hey!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh, hey. You're back early.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, yeah...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Um, uh... Amy?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you don't mind, do you want to go for a walk with me?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... Sorry. I'm a bit tired today...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: R-r-r-right? We did have gym class, after all...
Amy's footsteps are getting closer to the closet...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: H-huh? What are you trying to do?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm going to change.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, th-then...!
I hear Arcana's hurried footsteps, but...
*Click*
The closet door opens.
I meet Amy's eyes.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Gaaaaaah!
My gaze briefly goes to the open closet, but I remember Arcana saying there is only one closet.
Amy is sure to change clothes when she gets back...
I quickly lie flat on Arcana's bed and pull the blanket over me.
I feel Arcana straighten the blanket so it doesn't look suspicious, and sit down on the bed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: H-hey!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh, hey. You're back early.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, yeah...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: By the way, did you run into {AccountData.NickName}, by any chance?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: He was looking for you earlier.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, uhh... yeah!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: W-we met up riiight out front and talked. Yeah.
*Click*
Soon, I hear the sound of Amy opening the closet.
If I had hidden in the closet...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh, well...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Aren't you going to shower?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: No, I already showered at school, so I'm going straight to bed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I-is that so...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Um, if you don't mind.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do you want to step out for a short walk...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've heard that if you take a walk before bed, you sleep suuuper well!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Ah... sorry. Let's go next time.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm a bit tired today.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, okay...
Even after that, Arcana tries her best to lure Amy outside somehow...
But I can feel Amy climbing into the bed next to us instead.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh*
Arcana lets out a small sigh.
Then I hear the sound of her changing clothes.
*Rustle*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Shh.
Arcana slips under the blanket.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Move over a bit.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Look at you, all sweaty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you nervous?
Of course I am...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Just stay still and you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've noticed these past few days that Amy sleeps with her earphones in.
Arcana wipes the sweat beading on my forehead.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's wait a little longer, then sneak out.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Until then...
Arcana wraps her arms around my waist and buries her face in my chest.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hehe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't get any funny ideas.
... I won't.
... How can I not in a situation like this?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean, just a little would be okay.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mm... That's fair.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just... keep it in your head, okay?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Honestly, I'd be sadder if you didn't have any of those thoughts in a situation like this.
After nuzzling her cheek against my chest for a while, Arcana lets out a small giggle.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nothing. This whole situation's kinda funny, that's all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I never expected anything like this to happen.
... Me neither.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Still, doesn't it kinda feel like this is what being young is about?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Little episodes like this.
Arcana traces her fingertips across my palm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You can imagine the girl had a lot of mixed feelings...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: She used the boy's gym uniform as an excuse to invite him into her room,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but she probably hadn't thought about what would happen after.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Actually... maybe she chose not to think about it,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: because it's scary and overwhelming.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hold my hand.
I take Arcana's hand in mine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good... Now we just hold hands and fall asleep.
Wait, we're going to sleep?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. I am, at least. You can't.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You still have to sneak out later, after all.
... After I wait until Amy falls into a deeper sleep?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mm-hmm...
Arcana smiles and snuggles further into my arms.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Stay with me until I fall asleep.
Arcana closes her eyes, as if intent on falling asleep.
Soon, her breathing evens out.
About thirty minutes later, I carefully slip out of the bed.
Both Amy and Arcana seem to be fast asleep.
I gently smooth Arcana's bangs as she shifts slightly in her sleep.
... Sweet dreams.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mmm...
Arcana's eyes flutter open slightly.
Then she reaches out and cups my cheek.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... This is already a dream.
Yeah.
After that, I sneak out of the dorm,
and make it back to my room safely, where I try to get some sleep.
